doc: A job added to a bundle whose resources hold pipelines and no jobs (databricks.fbl#configuration; FBL 0.14, section 6.2; spec 066, FR-039; finding B11). Its body is written here, as the case of finding B11 of etalii.adp.ide.standalone's databricks-disl-fbl requirements: a new resource kind goes at the end of resources in FBL, where the module wrote it directly under resources:, by the conversion's question Q1, defaulted to what FBL writes.

steps.doc: A missing resource kind is created at the end of resources: (create at end), after pipelines, and the job is its first member, one step deeper.

splices.text:
nightly:
      name: nightly
      tasks:
        - task_key: main
          notebook_task:
            notebook_path: notebooks/nightly

expectFiles.../no-jobs.yml:
resources:
  pipelines:
    bronze:
      name: Bronze
  jobs:
    nightly:
      name: nightly
      tasks:
        - task_key: main
          notebook_task:
            notebook_path: notebooks/nightly

steps.doc: Undo puts back the bytes the add or removal replaced.
